measurement_interpretation.adverse_body: Post-anchor adverse-body bars are descriptive side-aware facts, not independent events.
measurement_interpretation.boundary_pressure: Left-pivot eligibility is measured relative to the profile pivot window.
measurement_interpretation.holdout: Later H1 cutoff membership is frozen as metadata only and has no published evaluation results.
measurement_interpretation.selection: Every fixed profile is measured on the same common development cutoffs.
measurement_interpretation.stability: Runs are observed contiguous segments with left/right censoring; they are not asserted true lifetimes.
measurement_interpretation.structural_history: Structural adverse-body history is retained descriptively and is not an objective.
measurement_interpretation.weighting: Sequential observations are reported descriptively and are not treated as independent samples.

resource_semantics.baseline_relative_ratio: descriptive only; not a stop gate
resource_semantics.execution: one serial process with no concurrent profile calls
resource_semantics.peak_process_rss_bytes: resource.getrusage ru_maxrss; bytes on macOS, KiB converted to bytes elsewhere
